name: Caprese Pork Chops

dupe_check.vs_catalog: No caprese / tomato-mozzarella-basil pork chop in the 21 catalog pork-chop recipes (all are gravy, mushroom, country-fried, smothered, marry-me-over-pasta, scalloped/hash-brown/stuffing casserole, or rice builds). Only balsamic pork is slow-cooker-balsamic-pork-bowls, a shredded-pork-over-rice bowl with no mozzarella or tomato caprese profile - different dish.
dupe_check.vs_accepted_slugs: No collision; nearest accepted pork is creamy-garlic-herb-wine-pork-chops (cream/wine sauce, distinct flavor family) and pulled-pork-stuffed-peppers.

cross_protein_collision_note: Structurally this is protein + fresh mozzarella + sliced tomato + fresh basil + balsamic reduction. A caprese chicken cutlet or caprese turkey cutlet would be the SAME DISH in a different protein - decider should watch other selectors' pools for a caprese/tomato-mozzarella-basil chicken or turkey candidate and dedupe cross-protein.
notes: One deliberate unmapped ingredient (sliced fresh mozzarella - board only tracks daiya-mozzarella-style-shreds); per v2.1 5.1 not penalized, routed to pricer queue. Widens catalog's thin Italian/caprese pork coverage.
evidence: Published recipe card: 496 cal / 56 g protein / 6 g carb per serving - dead-center calorie band, far under 35 g carb ceiling.
